highlights: Planting page: the gold label on the top photo now shows a tomato's growth type (Indeterminate, Determinate or Semi-determinate) and a pepper's heat range (for example 2.5K–8K SHU), as the June design intended; days to harvest stay in the crop card below. The two tomatillos no longer show a whole sentence there, and the small crop chip beside it now says Tomatillo on a tomatillo and Mint on Peppermint.

Planting page: the green growth-type pill on the crop card shows a real growth type or nothing. It no longer copies a plant's whole description onto peppers, basil, beans and 140 other non-tomato plants, and words like semi-woody or semi-upright no longer read as Semi-determinate.
Sun needs read Full sun, Part sun or Part shade on the crop card, the Details sheet, the top photo and search, instead of full_sun.

Behind the scenes: the Today page layout check and the Undo button check now run automatically on every change (their test pages draw text in Roboto, your phone's font), the harvest-weight check now tests the exact rule the app uses, and the whole-database data check no longer raises false alarms when another program leaves a shared database connection misconfigured.
